verdict.rationale: Storage pricing and free tiers are a fair question for a cloud file storage and collaboration product like Egnyte, so the axis applies. The evidence pack, including the pricing page excerpts, lists only paid feature capabilities. It never mentions a free tier, a published free storage quota, or free access to the same clients and API.

support.subject: As a power user, I can start free — a real free tier with published storage quota that works with the same clients and API
